$description: Mode-independent design tokens. In Figma these belong to a single-mode collection (suggested name: 'Global'). Every token name here is emitted verbatim as a CSS custom property, so the Figma variable name must equal the CSS name without the leading '--'.

accent-warn.$description: Amber highlight, e.g. university markers on the travel map.

radius-sm.$description: Matches Tailwind's default --radius-sm so `rounded-sm` is unchanged.

radius-md.$description: Matches Tailwind's default --radius-md so `rounded-md` is unchanged.

radius-lg.$description: Signature panel radius. Intentionally overrides Tailwind's 0.5rem default, so `rounded-lg` renders at 18px.

radius-full.$description: Pills and dots. Tailwind's `rounded-full` uses calc(infinity * 1px) and does not read this token.

text-micro.$description: Smallest label size (project card meta, stat captions).

text-body.$description: Long-form prose size used by MDX paragraphs and callouts.

shadow-soft.$description: Resting card elevation. Authored as a CSS shorthand string rather than a DTCG composite: Figma effects are styles, not variables, so shadows never arrive from a variable export and keeping the literal string guarantees byte-identical CSS.

shadow-hover.$description: Raised card elevation. See shadow-soft for why this is a string.
